title: Earthquake Shaking Potential for California — Second Local Refinement
warnings: This candidate composes four new schema-v2 local corrections with the five-control local refinement reviewed on port 8771 and the corrected affine baseline from port 8769.
The second-round displacement has 350-pixel support and decays smoothly to the port 8771 alignment outside each correction neighborhood.
All four new controls are fit exactly; the composed operation has a sampled Jacobian range of 0.945 to 1.053.
Each Modified Mercalli legend row is sampled as a range of color prototypes so hillshade/gradient variation is not mistaken for a new semantic class.
Pixels too close to two adjacent intensity ranges remain NoData.
This is an ordinal six-class interpretation of the legend, not a claim that a continuous physical measurement was recovered.
